title: Breach-probability family addendum 2: a drained pool's later price is not a market price (VOID, not graded)

disclosure.rule: For a forecast frozen on or after effective_from_freeze_day: find the first sample in its 14-day window at which the pool's in-range liquidity is below floor_ratio x its liquidity at the forecast's entry sample (the drain point). If the band was left at any sample BEFORE the drain point, the outcome is breach (y = 1), as before. If not, the row is VOID: published with its outcome evidence, but excluded from every test, from the INCOMPLETE share and from every count of resolved items. A row with no drain point is graded exactly as before. Coverage is checked first: a row below the coverage floor is INCOMPLETE whatever its liquidity.

constants.liquidity_measure: the pool's in-range (active) liquidity as sampled by the board's collector

disclosure.why: When nearly all liquidity leaves a concentrated-liquidity pool, its quoted price stops tracking the market: it can freeze, or jump on a dust trade. A frozen price inside the band reads as 'no breach' and would flatter the forecast; a jump could do the opposite. Neither says anything about whether the forecast was right. A breach before the drain point happened while the pool was a real market, so it still counts.
disclosure.why_this_threshold: 1% is deliberately extreme: in-range liquidity routinely moves by large factors as LPs re-range (rehearsal on SUI v2 samples found a pool at 1.9% of its entry liquidity mid-window that still traded). The rule removes only near-empty pools. Every row's lowest liquidity and its ratio to entry are published in the daily outcomes regardless, so the threshold can be judged in the open.
disclosure.not_covered: xrpl-v2 (AMM reserves, outcome computed from reserves), poolwatch-v2 (its collector records no liquidity), market-weather and sol-v2 (different families).
disclosure.unchanged: Every forecast field, model, band, coverage floor and verdict rule. Forecasts frozen before effective_from_freeze_day are graded exactly as before.
disclosure.immutability: Sealed before any forecast it governs exists. Any further change is another dated addendum.
